settings.heading: Our rules
settings.text: We are a small new store run by a family in Florida. These are the rules we run on, written down so you can hold us to them.

settings.heading: Where does my order ship from?
settings.row_content: From a warehouse in the United States. It leaves within 1–2 business days and the delivery window shown on the product page is the supplier's own figure.

settings.heading: Is shipping really included?
settings.row_content: Yes. The price on the product page is what you pay. Nothing is added at checkout.

settings.heading: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.row_content: Send a photo within 7 days of delivery. We replace it or refund, and you do not need to send it back.

settings.heading: Why are there so few reviews?
settings.row_content: Because we are new, and we only show reviews from verified buyers, asked after delivery with no reward attached. We would rather show three real ones than three hundred fake ones.

settings.heading: Is a raised bowl right for my pet?
settings.row_content: Our bowls are made for cats and dogs up to about 50 lb. Some veterinary studies do not recommend raised bowls for large and giant breeds; if your dog is one, ask your vet first. We make no health claims either way.
